name: @khorsheed/dsh-typesafe
description: TypeSafe (System One / Jev) decision primitives as a host service: typed noul/choice/score judgements through one named-question registry, with credential-reference key resolution, bounded timeout, retry, circuit breaker, cache and decision logs. Other plugins call it in code; the model-facing typesafe_judge tool ships as this package's ./tool composition entry, granted per session by an agent preset.

compat.notes: Provides a host-plane service and no model-facing surface, so it composes at the profile root. Key resolution reads the host credential store per call (ctx.credentials.resolve) and every outbound call is bounded: owned timeout + AbortSignal, 429/529 exponential backoff, circuit breaker, optional cache. A composition without the credentials service leaves the row pending rather than failing boot. The session-granted tool row folded back from the standalone `@khorsheed/dsh-typesafe-tool` companion into this package at the host-021 wave (2026-10-18, the T88 evaluation-family precedent) as the `./tool` composition entry — the preset row id `typesafe-tool` is unchanged, so a preset's composition state is unaffected once its row name points at `@khorsheed/dsh-typesafe/tool`; the old package name is retired.
